rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose adjective for something that keeps happening without stopping.

example.english: The continual rain lately makes me not even want to go out.
example.traditional: 呢排雨不停咁落，搞到我都唔想出街。
example.jyutping: ni1 paai4 jyu5 bat1 ting4 gam3 lok6 gaau2 dou3 ngo5 dou1 m4 soeng2 ceot1 gaai1

rows.note: Use this casual choice when something happens repeatedly or very often, rather than stressing literal unbroken continuity.

example.english: Your continual lateness is getting ridiculous—you’re late again this time.
example.traditional: 你成日遲到，今次又係喎。
example.jyutping: nei5 seng4 jat6 ci4 dou3 gam1 ci3 jau6 hai6 wo3

rows.note: Use this for an activity or state that continues seemingly without interruption or end.

example.english: The phone's continual ringing kept me from sleeping.
example.traditional: 個電話一直響，嘈到我瞓唔着。
example.jyutping: go3 din6 waa2 jat1 zik6 hoeng2 cou4 dou3 ngo5 fan3 m4 zoek6
